Cả ba định luật đều trả lời câu hỏi lực: All three laws answer what a force does: with zero net force the velocity stays the same (I), with a non-zero net force there is an acceleration a = F / m (II), and every force has a partner force acting on the other body (III); Law I is just the special case of Law II where the net force is 0.

Định luật II: a = F / m (F = hợp lực): Law II: a = F / m  (F = net force)
